description: Recreation of the Yamaha OPL2 FM chip: two oscillators, the first modulating the second or the two summed, with eight wavetables, feedback, a reverb, velocity and four sound slots to morph between

params.text: Sets the frequency multiplier of that oscillator, where 0 gives half the input pitch
Sets the feedback of oscillator 1, which enriches the harmonics, makes saw-like and pulse-like waves, and at the top produces noise
Switches the engine between FM, where oscillator 1 modulates oscillator 2, and additive, where the two are summed
Sets the output of oscillator 1, which in FM is the amount of modulation it applies to oscillator 2
Sets the attack time of that oscillator's envelope
Sets the decay time of that oscillator's envelope
Sets the sustain level of that oscillator's envelope
Sets the release time of that oscillator's envelope
Sets the output level of oscillator 2
Steps through the eight wavetables of that oscillator: sine, half sine, rectified sine, quarter sine, double cycle sine, triangle, square and saw
Steps through the envelope types of that oscillator, ADR or ADSR in linear or exponential form, where the ADR types skip the sustain and go from decay straight to release
Sets the amount of reverb added to the output
Sets how much the VEL input changes the level of that oscillator, from no effect fully counter-clockwise to the level set entirely by velocity fully clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the modulation input of the same number before it reaches its destination
Assigns that modulation input: press it, then move the control it should change
Turns morph mode on, where the MORPH input interpolates between the four saved sounds and the controls change the interpolated sound from where they stand
Recalls the sound kept in that slot with a single press, and saves the current sound into it when held for about 2 seconds

inputs.text: The gate that starts the envelopes and releases them when it falls
The velocity of the note, which changes the oscillator levels by the amount the VEL controls set
In morph mode this voltage interpolates between the saved sounds: 0V is slot 1, 1V is slot 2, and voltages outside 0-4V are wrapped into that range
A control voltage for the destination assigned to the modulation selector of the same number

outputs.text: The envelope of oscillator 1 or of oscillator 2, whichever the menu picks

notes: the screen and the buttons beside it are not implemented, so the settings they would reach are on the right-click menu
a modulation input does nothing until its slot is assigned: press the modulation button, then move the control the slot should change, or pick the destination from the right-click menu
morph mode interpolates between sounds already stored in the four slots, so store them first: hold a slot button for about 2 seconds until its lamp flashes twice
132 factory sounds from the Ad Lib library ship with the module and are loaded from the preset list in the right-click menu
menu: Mode — FM, where oscillator 1 modulates oscillator 2, or Additive, where the two are summed; the panel switch makes the same choice
Env-Output — picks which envelope the ENV jack carries, Env-1 or Env-2
Shape-1 — picks the wavetable of oscillator 1 directly: Sine, Sine 1/2, Sine Rect, Sine 1/4, Sine 2x, Triangle, Square or Saw
Env-1 — picks the envelope of oscillator 1: ADR (Lin), ADSR (Lin), ADR (Exp) or ADSR (Exp), where the ADR forms skip the sustain and go from decay straight to release
Tremolo-1 — sets the tremolo depth of oscillator 1, Off, 1, 2, 3 or 4, from an LFO of about 3.7Hz
Vibrato-1 — sets the vibrato depth of oscillator 1, Off, 1, 2, 3 or 4, from an LFO of about 6.4Hz
Key-Scale-Level-1 — attenuates oscillator 1 as the pitch rises, by 0dB, 1.5dB, 3dB or 6dB per octave
Detune-1 — detunes oscillator 1, in multiples from 0.0 to 0.9
Shape-2 — picks the wavetable of oscillator 2 directly: Sine, Sine 1/2, Sine Rect, Sine 1/4, Sine 2x, Triangle, Square or Saw
Env-2 — picks the envelope of oscillator 2: ADR (Lin), ADSR (Lin), ADR (Exp) or ADSR (Exp), where the ADR forms skip the sustain and go from decay straight to release
Tremolo-2 — sets the tremolo depth of oscillator 2, Off, 1, 2, 3 or 4, from an LFO of about 3.7Hz
Vibrato-2 — sets the vibrato depth of oscillator 2, Off, 1, 2, 3 or 4, from an LFO of about 6.4Hz
Key-Scale-Level-2 — attenuates oscillator 2 as the pitch rises, by 0dB, 1.5dB, 3dB or 6dB per octave
Detune-2 — detunes oscillator 2, in multiples from 0.0 to 0.9
M1 — picks the destination of modulation input 1 from the twenty-one targets
M2 — picks the destination of modulation input 2 from the twenty-one targets
